extracted_fields.hardware_or_process_assumptions: HLS code-debugging evaluation with a CodeT5-Large encoder-decoder: 24 encoder and 24 decoder transformer layers, 1024-dimensional embeddings, 16-dimensional heads and three-layer MLP prediction heads; no HLS compiler, synthesis, timing, area, power or independent functional/equivalence check is part of the reported correction metric.
extracted_fields.workload_or_design_corpus: A random 2,000-sample subset of an existing HLS logic-bug benchmark covering eight injected bug types; training data comprises roughly 30K crawled HLS samples, roughly 10K GPT-3.5 RTL-to-HLS augmentations, and about 300K generated labeled buggy samples after removing approximately 2K samples with Rouge-L similarity above 0.5.

limits: Full-paper extraction from author preprint; generated mutation distribution, semantic leakage outside the Rouge-L threshold, natural-bug transfer, compilation/equivalence validity, hardware effects, cost and independent review remain unresolved.
title: HLSDebugger: Identification and Correction of Logic Bugs in HLS Code with LLM Solutions

extracted_fields.hardware_or_process_assumptions: GPU side-channel evaluation under a shared/virtualized NVIDIA GPU threat model where an unprivileged user reads nvidia-smi/pynvml power and thermal telemetry; main experiments use an NVIDIA A40, with GTX 1660 Ti Mobile for gradient analysis, approximately 28 C initial temperature and cooling between laboratory traces. Device, driver, MIG/virtualization and sensor-policy details constrain transfer.
extracted_fields.workload_or_design_corpus: Nine custom transformer configurations, eight pre-trained language models spanning T5/Google/MarianMT/Meta, and eight ViTs spanning Apple/Google/Meta/Microsoft; 100 traces per model over 120 seconds at 7 Hz, 80:20 split with stratified K-fold, single- and noisy-multi-process settings. Background workloads include matrix multiplication, CNN and ViT inference; downstream tests include MarianMT substitution and ViT FGSM/PGD transfer attacks.

limits: Full-preprint extraction; classification is not weight or training-data recovery, and selected families/configurations limit generalization. Sensor visibility, device/driver/sampling policy, co-tenancy, trace collection, family conditioning, attack definitions and mitigation effectiveness remain unresolved; no independent reproduction was performed.
source_locators: 7 Hz/28 C/120 s/100 traces/80:20 and K-fold conditions
title: Energon: Unveiling Transformers from GPU Power and Thermal Side-Channels
